description: The visuals of a feedback item, in one call: call it before acting on any item with a visuals field (a recording, a drawing, images). For a recording: a frame for EVERY pointing link in its content ([phrase](#rt=S), the reviewer's "this" / "here"), each labelled with the links it shows, the media under review with the reviewer's drawing rendered in, and their shared SCREEN when they demonstrated something (e.g. a Photoshop/Figma mockup); webcam frames are NOT included, and the transcript is returned marked [FRAME N]. For a text comment: a standalone drawing (has_drawing: true) rendered onto the frame it was drawn over, and the comment's images. Returns up to 12 images; a link the cap left out is named, for get_frame. Use get_frame only for a moment this did not show.
